2137. Sorting an Array in Ascending Order Using Bubble Sort

80

Hard

Problem Statement
Read N integers into an array and print them sorted in ascending order, using the bubble sort technique with nested loops.

Description
Read an integer N, then read N integers into a one-dimensional array. Use bubble sort to sort the array: repeatedly compare each pair of adjacent elements using an outer and inner loop, and swap them using a temporary variable if they are in the wrong order. After sorting is complete, print the array elements in ascending order.
input_spec: An integer N, followed by N integers separated by spaces.
output_spec: Print the N array elements in ascending order, separated by spaces.
